subject: Taxes
title: Chainalysis: Following the Money
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Chainalysis: Following the Money.

hook.text: Chainalysis mapped 80% of Bitcoin transactions to real identities.

buildup.text: Chainalysis software traces crypto flows across wallets, exchanges, and mixers.

discovery.text: The company's tools helped the IRS seize $3.5 billion in crypto from a single tax fraud case in 2022.

twist.text: Privacy coins like Monero were supposed to be untraceable.

climax.text: Blockchain analytics turned crypto's greatest strength—transparency—into its greatest vulnerability for tax evaders.

punchline.text: $3.5 billion seized in one case. Blockchain analytics made crypto traceable.

quiz.question: What was the largest crypto seizure by the IRS?
